_about: Denial Intelligence seed (E3). `disputes` is the working layer over a request that needs a payer-decision response; request.stage stays the only lifecycle and the dispute status is derived from it (web/js/shared/sel/disputes.js, reconciled after every action by server/psyflo/actions/x-disputes.js). `dispute_evidence` are dated records the workspace reads (synthetic, provenance 'seed': shown as Illustrative sample). `drafting_rules` is the list of rules Psyflo applies to every draft (read by Settings and the payer guidance drawer). Synthetic data only.

Ethan's weekly counseling has not stopped his use: four counselor reports in October, including a positive THC screen on Oct 5. Harvest's intensive outpatient program is the only structured daily support available to him. Please review the attached records and approve the 90 units requested.

drafting_rules.title: Dates within the last 30 days
drafting_rules.text: anything offered as current evidence; older facts carry their date

drafting_rules.title: Counts, never percentages
drafting_rules.text: "3 of 5 weekly screens negative", "6 dated use episodes (Oct 2, 6, 9, 14, 20, 22)": the forms ask that way

drafting_rules.title: Every dimension rated Moderate or higher is documented
drafting_rules.text: a rating of 2 or more needs an instrument score or dated records for that dimension (D1 withdrawal screen, D3 PHQ-9 or GAD-7, D5 dated use or screens); a rating of None or Mild is not argued

drafting_rules.title: Interventions named from Harvest's list
drafting_rules.text: with why it was used (refusal skills practice before a weekend party), not just that it happened

drafting_rules.title: Every note names a treatment plan goal
drafting_rules.text: and states progress as a count

drafting_rules.title: No "observed"
drafting_rules.text: direct-support notes say what the staffer did ("worked with", "prompted", "used")

drafting_rules.title: Prior treatment names the level, provider, dates and outcome
drafting_rules.text: an empty outcome blocks the draft and asks the question; "information about outpatient" and pro-bono contacts do not count as prior care

drafting_rules.title: Referral partner counseling goes under care coordination
drafting_rules.text: never as the failed prior treatment

drafting_rules.title: State the level and the dimensions that drive it
drafting_rules.text: the draft names the dimensions that are above the next lower level, from the stored ratings; when the ratings fit a lower level it asks the clinician for the reason

drafting_rules.title: Nothing the clinician marked exclude
drafting_rules.text: and nothing from the family that is not on the form's question; household disclosures stay out unless the clinician presses Include

drafting_rules.title: Psyflo never rates a dimension or chooses a level
drafting_rules.text: ratings and the level recommendation are the clinician's; drafts quote the stored assessment and leave a blank where the clinician must decide

drafting_rules.title: Answer the question and stop
drafting_rules.text: on information requests: three items asked, three answered, nothing added

drafting_rules.title: Vary language across days
drafting_rules.text: if a staffer's last 30 notes share a paragraph, the enhancer varies it and the supervisor sees the pattern

drafting_rules.title: Quiet day rule
drafting_rules.text: a day with no use, no cravings and no concerns says what skill was practiced and what still needs follow-up
